acrylic_materials.scope: Visible-light scalar approximations. Supplier nominal values are not independent RGB or angle-resolved measurements. Finished-sheet values already include the substrate; do not apply an extra acrylic transmission factor.

two_way_mirror.evidence: Supplier nominal technical specification for finished clear acrylic mirror. Spectral and directional response are not published.

black_led.evidence: Chemcast Black LED sheet: approximately 29% light transmission. Surface reflectance is a normal-incidence Fresnel estimate from PMMA n=1.49, not a measured black-sheet reflectance. This is a source cover, not a 70/30 mirror.

clear_reference.evidence: PERSPEX Design Guide Table 18 reports >92% transmission at 3 mm (ASTM D1003), refractive index 1.49 (ISO 489 A). 0.92 is a rounded conservative reference for uncoated clear stock; do not multiply it into finished mirror transmission.

black_mirror.evidence: Engineering estimate requested by Bryan, not measured data. Assume similar cavity-facing coating reflectance to the clear mirror. Clear finished mirror T=.30, black LED stock T=.29, clear stock T=.92 imply .30*.29/.92=.0946, rounded to .09. Cavity-facing absorption is then .21. Reverse-side reflection is rounded to .10 from PMMA surface reflection plus the attenuated coating return; reverse absorption is .81. Values describe the complete coated black sheet: never multiply by .29 again.

comparison.status: Rear clear mirror: supplier-nominal R70/T30. Custom coated black front: estimated cavity-side R70/T9/absorption21, reverse-side R10/T9/absorption81. This complete-sheet estimate already includes black substrate loss. Uncoated black centre T29 is supplier nominal. No measured data establish the custom coated black sheet; scattering, RGB, glow and assembly response remain unmeasured

design.selected_finish: black LED acrylic centre, cavity-facing mirror annulus, opaque rim

mass_estimate.basis: Complete installed-component estimate; independent low/high allowances summed, not a confidence interval. Printed PETG uses CAD solid-volume ceiling; fit samples, brims, retail stock, spares and charger excluded.

glow.label: Glow PETG
glow.evidence: Adafruit demonstrated ColorFabb glowFill PLA/PHA with NeoPixels. Selected PETG has a different formulation; qualify production-wall samples.
glow.acceptance: Review LED patterns at the permitted power limit. Record green afterglow immediately and after 1, 5 and 15 minutes.
glow.nozzle: Use an abrasion-resistant, non-high-flow 0.4 mm nozzle for Ultraglow. Prusa recommends 0.6 mm to reduce clogging; inspect these 0.4 mm production paths before release.

silver.label: Silver PETG
silver.density_basis: Extrudr PETG family nominal density; verify the silver lot and printed mass
silver.evidence: Christopher Parrott tested 0.4 mm Rigid.ink silver PLA. This PETG candidate and the thicker production walls have not passed optical qualification.
silver.acceptance: Test white, red, green, blue and moving rainbow patterns through both production wall thicknesses. If the silver is opaque or the patterns are unacceptable, stop this version. Keep the 2.0 mm outside wall; do not replace it with a 0.4 mm membrane.
silver.nozzle: Use a 0.4 mm non-high-flow nozzle and qualified PETG settings. Inspect the same complete wall paths as the glow version.
